race.description: Barbagallo Aston Martin Conditioned Hcp Ss Pace
race.comment: SEASIDE POND NZ (10) has enjoyed the switch to standing start races and gets another here. Made it two wins in a row when successful at his latest appearance at Pinjarra, getting home by 5.5 metres. Going well enough to come from the 20m mark and land the hat trick. FRANCO MOTU NZ (13) was a beaten favourite last time but does start closer in the handicap. Good in recording a resuming win here prior so is worth another chance. ARTFUL MAJOR (14) came from this mark in last-start fourth behind Seaside Pond at Listed level and placed at this venue prior. ALCOPONY (12) last appeared when third from the 20m mark here nine weeks ago. Worth including.
